about: B2s/B3s sacred props for the walk-in interiors (contract 11, design 11.2). Each GLB is standalone: KTX2 textures (KHR_texture_basisu; albedo ETC1S sRGB, normal/ORM UASTC+Zstd), glTF +Y up, metres, the object's front faces +Z (glTF) and its origin is at the bottom centre (statues: base on the floor/plinth; wall pieces: bottom edge, back against the wall at z = 0). <name>_phone.glb is the phone LOD with 512 px maps (glass: half size). Materials named M_pbr_<set> carry only a fallback colour + metre UVs: bind pbrLibrary.getPbrSet(<set>) at load. Sources and licences: docs/designs/village-lots-v2/tools/sacred/SOURCES.md.
gpuMB: texture GPU memory with mips (1 byte/texel), shared by every instance of the same GLB

items.what: 성모상 (Virgin and Child), white Carrara marble
items.place: on the 'mary' plinth (solid 0.8 x 0.7, total 2.4 m): plinth top ~1.05 m, facing the nave (+z of the room)

items.what: 성인상 A (friar with cross and book), marble
성인상 B (young knight with shield), marble — optional second saint (e.g. a side niche or the loft stair)

items.place: apse wall above the altar, bottom ~2.2 m; it is meant to be seen from the front (pews)

items.material: M_glass_stained: base + emissive = glass colour (scale emissiveIntensity by daylight), came in normal/ORM; saddle bars cast_iron; lead edge M_lead

items.what: figurative lancet: Assumption with angels, in grisaille
rose window, 2.4 m, 3D stone tracery (M_pbr_stone_ashlar) + figurative glass
Station of the Cross: moulded oak plaque 0.36 x 0.50 m with a small oak cross; child meshes ..._num_01..14 are the bronze numerals I..XIV — show exactly one per placed station
items.place: 14 along the side walls at ~1.4 m (bottom edge), 7 per side, I near the sanctuary on the left going round to XIV

본존불: seated Buddha on its lotus seat, gilded (개금) with dark-blue hair curls

items.what: 협시보살: standing gilt bodhisattva — place TWICE, left as is and right mirrored (scale.x = -1), shared textures
items.place: on the 수미단 either side of the Buddha (x ~3.6 and ~7.8)

items.what: 후불탱화 3.6 m wide in silk border and red-lacquer frame (M_pbr_dancheong_wood fallback)
items.place: back wall behind the 수미단, bottom ~2.2 m so it rises above the Buddha's halo

pc.tris: Mary 14k + saint A 12k (+ saint B 12k) + crucifix 14k + 3 lancets 1.8k + rose 12.9k + 14 stations ≈ 55–67k of 140k
